detail.title: CP-UNR-4K5082-FI
features: Up to 8 channel IP camera input
Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG codec decoding
AI by recorder: 2 Channel face detection and recognition, up to 20 face databases  and 20,000 face images, 4 Channel perimeter protection, 8 Channel IMD+
AI by Camera: Face detection and recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD+,  Metadata, ANPR, Stereo analysis, Heat map, People counting
Support 2 SATA HDDs up to 20TB Each, 2 USB Ports (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 3.0 port)

General.Video Output: 1 VGA:1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720        1 HDMI:3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720   Heterogeneous video source output for HDMI and VGA
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2 Channel 32MP@25 fps, 2 Channel 24MP@25 fps, 4 Channel 16MP@30 fps, 5  Channel 12MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 8MP@30 fps       AI enabled: 1 Channel 32MP@25 fps, 1 Channel 24MP@25 fps, 2 Channel 16MP@30 fps, 4  Channel 12MP@30 fps, 6 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 6MP@30 fps, 8 Channel  5MP@30 fps
General.AI by NVR: Face detection, Face recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD+
General.AI by Camera: Face detection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor vehicles, and non-motor  vehicles), Perimeter protection, IMD, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting,              ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map, PPE detection, Smart object detection, Smart sound detection
General.IntelliCheck AI by Camera + Recorder: Max. 8 Channel, 1 combined event per Channel/s
General.Perimeter Performance AI by NVR (Number: 4 Channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel
General.Perimeter Performance of AI by Camera (N: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 8 targets per second.
General.Face Attributes: Gender, Age group, Glasses, Expressions, Face mask, Beard
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 384 Mbps incoming, 384 Mbps recording and 384 Mbps outgoing   AI enabled: 200 Mbps incoming, 200 Mbps recording and 200 Mbps outgoing
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 Channels (up to 12 face images/s each Channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 20 face databases with 20,000 images, with a total capacity of 2.5 G. Name, Gender,  Birthday, Address, Credential type, Credential No., Countries & Regions and state can be  added to each face image
General.Face Recognition Performance of AI by NV: 1.8 Channel FD (by camera) + FR (by NVR), image stream: 16 face images/s 2.2 Channel FD (by NVR) + FR (by NVR), video stream: 12 face images/s
General.IMD+ by NVR: 8 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.IMD By Camera: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 16 targets per second
General.Human Attributes: Top color, Top type, Bottom color, Bottom type, Hat, Bag, Age, Gender and Umbrella
General.Motor Vehicle Attributes: License plate, Plate color, Vehicle body, Vehicle model, Vehicle logo, Calling, Seatbelt, Vehicle  interior, Vehicle registration location
General.Non-motor Vehicle Attributes: Vehicle model, Vehicle color, Number of persons, Helmet
General.ANPR by Camera (Number of Channels): Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 8 targets per second
General.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers, 2. Blocklist and allowlist
General.Abnormality Alarm: Error (No disk, Disk error, Low space, Low quota space, Abnormal disk health, Network  disconnection, IP conflict, MAC conflict, Abnormal fan speed), Video loss, Video tampering,  Camera offline, Audio detection
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection, Perimeter protection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor  vehicles and Non-motor vehicles), IMD+, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People  counting, ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map, PPE detection, Smart object detection, Smart  sound detection
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Local alarm, Alarm box, Camera external alarm, Network alarm, Scene  changing, PIR alarm, Thermal alarm
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), Local alarm output, IPC external alarm output, Audio, Buzzer,  Log, Preset, Email
General.Hard Disk: 2 SATA ports, each disk can contain up to 20 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature
General.Record Mode: General, Motion detection, Intelligent, Alarm, POS
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Target video, Video clip, Tag playback, Smart playback (face and motion detection)
General.Interface Ports: 2 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 3.0 port), 1 RS232, 1 RS485
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, DDNS, Alarm Server, Multicast,  P2P, Auto Connect, iSCSI, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S, Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Power Consumption: Total output of NVR is ≤ 10 W (without HDD)
